tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): distinguish nil MCPServers from explicit empty slice

beadle-p43a: ClaudeRunner.Run used len(servers) == 0 to decide whether
to fall back to the default MCP server set, which treats a recipe's
explicit MCPServers: [] the same as an omitted field -- silently
over-granting an MCP surface the recipe author opted out of. Only a
nil slice (field omitted) should get the default.
EOF
)"
